title: InkloomAuditResult
description: Standardized, versioned audit result schema for Inkloom AI brand governance checks across backend, frontend, AI audit engine, and media QA modules.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the audit contract schema

audit_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific audit run

content_id.description: Identifier of the content submission or revision being audited

overall_status.description: Aggregated governance compliance status of the audited content

summary.description: Human-readable executive summary of audit findings

findings.description: Detailed list of brand governance findings detected during the audit

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the audit was generated

title.description: Short descriptive title of the finding

message.description: Detailed explanation of why this violates brand guidelines

evidence.description: Actual excerpt, color value, or metric extracted from the submitted content. Null if missing/unavailable.

source_reference.description: Authoritative guideline rule ID, style guide section, or approved asset reference. Null if missing or unavailable. Never fabricate citations.

confidence.description: Algorithmic confidence in this finding (0.0 to 1.0). Kept separate from severity.

suggested_correction.description: Actionable suggested replacement preserving creator intent, or null if manual review is required.

requires_human_review.description: Indicates whether human confirmation is required before this issue can be resolved

Location.description: Specific coordinate, text range, or page where finding occurs

engine_version.description: Version of the AI audit engine and ruleset

ai_model_used.description: Identifier of the LLM or vision model if invoked, or null if deterministic rules only

extractors_used.description: List of media extractors invoked (e.g. text_extractor, pdf_parser, ocr_processor)
